sources.text: The Washington DC metro area — Maryland, Virginia, and DC — is one of the highest-compensating security markets in the United States, driven by the concentration of federal agencies, defense contractors, and government-adjacent commercial tenants who require security personnel with specialized credentials and clearances. Understanding the pay structure and career path in this market is essential for anyone considering a security career here — or transitioning from military or law enforcement. Security Officer Salary Ranges in the DC Metro Area Compensation varies significantly based on armed/unarmed status, clearance level, and contract type. Current market ranges: Unarmed, entry-level, commercial: $16–$22/hr Armed, state-licensed, commercial: $20–$28/hr Unarmed, federal contract (public trust): $22–$30/hr — federal contracts frequently carry Service Contract Act wage determinations that set a floor above commercial rates Armed, Secret clearance, federal contract: $28–$40/hr Armed, Top Secret clearance, federal contract: $35–$55/hr Supervisory positions: Add 20–40% above officer rates depending on scope The Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics publishes current wage data for security guards (SOC 33-9032) by metropolitan area. The Washington-Arlington-Alexandria DC-VA-MD-WV metro consistently ranks among the top five compensation markets nationally for security personnel. The Service Contract Act and Federal Security Pay Federal security service contracts are generally covered by the McNamara-O’Hara Service Contract Act (SCA) , administered by the Department of Labor. The SCA requires contractors to pay at least the prevailing wage and fringe benefits determined by DOL for the specific type of work and geographic location. In practice, this means security officers on federal contracts in the DC Metro earn more than counterparts on commercial contracts for equivalent work — often significantly more when the SCA’s health and welfare fringe benefit rate is included. A federal contract officer earning $28/hr plus the SCA H&W fringe benefit (currently over $5.00/hr) has total compensation well above what a $28/hr commercial officer receives. Understanding this comparison is important when evaluating employment offers. What Federal Security Employers Look for Beyond Licensing Military or Law Enforcement Background Prior military service — particularly military police, security forces, or combat arms — and law enforcement experience are the strongest differentiators for federal security positions. The operational discipline, chain-of-command familiarity, report writing, and situational awareness from these backgrounds translate directly to high-performance federal security work. Veterans transitioning to security careers in the DC Metro have a significant advantage in this market. Active Clearance Status An active clearance — particularly Secret or above — dramatically increases both employability and earning potential. Officers who hold active clearances from prior military or government employment can begin work on federal contracts within weeks rather than months. Maintaining clearance currency is an asset that compounds in value across a security career. Report Writing and Documentation Quality Security incident reports that are clear, factual, timely, and legally defensible are a consistent professional differentiator in the federal market. Contractors who work for high-accountability federal clients have low tolerance for vague, untimely, or inaccurate reports. Supervisors who can identify strong documentation skills in officers and develop that skill in their teams are highly valued. Physical Fitness and Medical Readiness Many federal security positions require passing a physical fitness assessment and maintaining weight and physical standards. Armed positions additionally require maintaining firearms qualification on a defined cycle. Officers who let physical standards or firearms qualification lapse create staffing problems for their employers and risk removal from cleared posts. Career Advancement Path in Federal Security Security Officer: Entry-level post assignment — access control, patrol, incident reporting Armed Security Officer: Requires armed licensing in relevant states, annual firearms qualification, and typically a track record in unarmed assignments first Senior Security Officer / Post Commander: Leads a post team, ensures post order compliance, guides junior officers Shift Supervisor: Responsible for all posts across a shift, officer accountability, incident response, direct client communication Site Supervisor / Project Manager: Overall responsibility for a facility or contract, including staffing, compliance documentation, client relationship management, and quality control Specialized Roles: Risk assessment specialist, personnel security specialist, emergency management coordinator — typically requiring ASIS certifications (CPP, PSP) or emergency management credentials alongside field experience Current Openings at Securemedy Incorporated Securemedy Incorporated is an SBA 8(a), MBE, and DBE certified federal security contractor operating across 16 states, headquartered in Oxon Hill, Maryland. We actively recruit armed and unarmed security officers, site supervisors, risk assessment specialists, and emergency management coordinators across our federal and commercial contract portfolio in Maryland, Virginia, and DC. View all current openings on our Careers page , including positions requiring Secret clearances, supervisory roles in the DC Metro, and specialized assignments tied to our full service portfolio . We offer compensation calibrated to federal SCA wage determinations where applicable, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, retirement), uniform and equipment provided at no cost, and clear advancement pathways for high-performing officers. We are particularly interested in candidates with active clearances, military or law enforcement backgrounds, and demonstrated performance on federal security contracts. Our track record across federal clients — including the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and U.S. Army Barnes Federal Building — reflects the standard we expect from every officer we bring on, and the opportunity that standard creates for career advancement. Frequently Asked Questions Is a security guard license in Maryland valid to work in Virginia? No. Maryland and Virginia have separate licensing regimes with no automatic reciprocity. Working an armed or unarmed security post in Virginia requires separate DCJS registration, including completion of Virginia’s Entry Level Training requirement. Officers who hold Maryland registration need to complete Virginia’s licensing process before working any Virginia assignment. What is the fastest way to increase my earning potential as a security officer in the DC area? Two paths are most impactful: obtaining armed licensure in all three jurisdictions (Maryland, Virginia, and DC) and pursuing clearance eligibility if you have a qualifying background. Armed federal contract officers with active Secret clearances represent the highest-compensated segment of the uniformed security workforce in this market, and that population is consistently undersupplied relative to demand. Do security companies in DC provide training to help officers get armed licenses? Reputable security companies — including Securemedy — sponsor officers through the training and licensing process for armed endorsements in the jurisdictions where they operate. If an employer is not willing to invest in your licensing in return for a reasonable service commitment, that is a signal about how they view their workforce. Companies that invest in officer credentials have lower turnover and better operational performance — which is why we do it. View all current openings on our Careers page , including positions requiring Secret clearances, supervisory roles in the DC Metro, and specialized assignments tied to our full service portfolio . We offer compensation calibrated to federal SCA wage determinations where applicable, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, retirement), uniform and equipment provided at no cost, and clear advancement pathways for high-performing officers. We are particularly interested in candidates with active clearances, military or law enforcement backgrounds, and demonstrated performance on federal security contracts. Our track record across federal clients — including the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and U.S. Army Barnes Federal Building — reflects the standard we expect from every officer we bring on, and the opportunity that standard creates for career advancement. Frequently Asked Questions Is a security guard license in Maryland valid to work in Virginia? No. Maryland and Virginia have separate licensing regimes with no automatic reciprocity. Working an armed or unarmed security post in Virginia requires separate DCJS registration, including completion of Virginia’s Entry Level Training requirement. Officers who hold Maryland registration need to complete Virginia’s licensing process before working any Virginia assignment. What is the fastest way to increase my earning potential as a security officer in the DC area? Two paths are most impactful: obtaining armed licensure in all three jurisdictions (Maryland, Virginia, and DC) and pursuing clearance eligibility if you have a qualifying background. Armed federal contract officers with active Secret clearances represent the highest-compensated segment of the uniformed security workforce in this market, and that population is consistently undersupplied relative to demand. Do security companies in DC provide training to help officers get armed licenses? Reputable security companies — including Securemedy — sponsor officers through the training and licensing process for armed endorsements in the jurisdictions where they operate. If an employer is not willing to invest in your licensing in return for a reasonable service commitment, that is a signal about how they view their workforce. Companies that invest in officer credentials have lower turnover and better operational performance — which is why we do it. I have read and understood the terms and conditions outlined in this SMS consent form, and I voluntarily provide my consent to receive SMS messages from Securemedy for recruitment-related purposes.

sources.title: $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge – Securemedy Nigeria Limited
sources.text: $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge Rewarding our security personnel for their professional appearance August 1, 2024 - August 31, 2024. Our Objective The purpose of this challenge is to motivate and reward our security personnel for maintaining and enhancing their professional appearance, which reflects the company's commitment to excellence and professionalism at all worksites. Prize Categories 1st place First Place: $5,000 Our top prize! This substantial reward goes to the security personnel who best exemplifies our standards of professionalism and excellence. 2nd place Second Place: $2,500 Still a significant reward, the second place prize is for the personnel who comes close to meeting the high bar set by our first place winner. 3rd place Third Place: $1,000 Recognition for your commitment to maintaining a professional appearance, the third place prize is our way of saying 'well done!' Eligibility Criteria Open to all uniformed security personnel employed by the company and in good standing Evaluation Criteria Uniform Neatness and Fit We're looking for security personnel who wear their uniforms with pride. Your uniform should be properly fitted, clean, and well-maintained. Grooming Personal grooming is a key part of professional appearance. Compliance with our grooming policy is essential, which includes aspects like hair, facial hair, nails, and personal hygiene. Professionalism Professionalism isn't just about how you look, it's also about how you act. We'll be evaluating your posture, communication, and conduct. Consistency Consistency is key in this challenge. We're looking for security personnel who maintain high appearance standards throughout the contest period. Note: Eligible participants must meet ALL the mandatory requirements as outlined in CEO Directive_ CD 007.1 Image and Appearance Standards (NO EXCEPTIONS!!!) CEO DIRECTIVE CD_007 Image and Appearance Standards Contest Period The $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge takes place from August 1, 2024, to October 31, 2024. During this 3-month period, participants must register, maintain a professional appearance, and be evaluated by a judging panel. Winners will be announced after October 31, 2024. Entry Process 01 Step #1 Participants must complete a registration form. 02 Step #2 Registration must include 2 clear pictures of officer in uniform (head to toe) including: Front View & Rear View 03 Step #3 Registration, with pictures to be submitted via email to admin@securemedy.com by Friday, August 30, 2024, at 5:00pm Extra Credit Exercise To improve chances of selection, eligible applicants may submit a 1-paragraph, brief statement outlining their approach to maintaining their professional appearance. EXTRA CREDIT Judging Process Evaluating Excellence Panel of corporate management judges to evaluate entries based on the criteria listed. Behind the Scenes Judge(s) will conduct random in-person site visits to observe participants on work site Deciding the Best Judges will select the highest rated candidates (all criteria met) for consideration of prizes From Submission to Selection Final selections to be made no later than November 30, 2024, by 5:00pm The Path to Victory Winners to be announced during upcoming 15-year Anniversary Employee Appreciation Gala Registration Form Contact Information For any questions or further information, please contact Ms. Unique Brooks, Office Administrator Telephone +1 240-419-3125 Email Address admin@securemedy.com

sources.text: Security Operations What Real Protection Actually Looks Like A uniform shows that someone is present. Real protection is built earlier, in how a company hires, trains, supervises and responds. Published Aug 12, 2026 Reading time 5 min read Author Securemedy Incorporated Category Security Operations In This Article Most people picture security as an officer near an entrance. This article argues that the picture is incomplete: protection is built long before an officer arrives on site, through hiring, training, supervision and the way a company responds when something goes wrong. It draws on Securemedy’s years of operation since 2009 and sets out three qualities that define dependable protection, along with the questions worth asking when you evaluate a provider. Key Takeaways Consistency: reliable scheduling and backup coverage matter as much as who shows up on day one. Judgment: training prepares officers to read a situation, de-escalate and coordinate with authorities. Accountability: supervisors who check in and reporting that is actually reviewed. When choosing a provider, ask how they train and supervise, how long they have operated and what happens when something goes wrong. sources.text: Security Insights Armed vs. Unarmed Security Guards: How to Choose What's Right for Your Property Armed or unarmed coverage should be a site-by-site assessment, not a default setting. Here are the factors worth weighing. Published Jun 4, 2026 Reading time 5 min read Author Securemedy Incorporated Category Security Insights In This Article Facility managers and business owners often ask whether they need armed security or whether unarmed coverage is enough. Securemedy treats the question as a site-by-site assessment rather than a default. The article explains how the two differ in training, licensing and the risks they are suited to, lists the factors worth weighing, and describes how Securemedy starts with a site assessment before recommending a posture. Key Takeaways Unarmed officers are trained in observation, access control, de-escalation, report writing and emergency response coordination. Armed coverage carries additional certification and ongoing firearms qualification, and suits sites with higher documented risk, cash handling or high-value assets. Weigh actual risk history, insurance and contract requirements, local licensing law, foot traffic and stakeholder expectations. Securemedy is as comfortable recommending unarmed coverage as armed. The goal is fit, not upsell. Read the Full Article The complete article, “Armed vs. Unarmed Security Guards: How to Choose What's Right for Your Property”, is published on the Securemedy blog. sources.text: Public Safety Suspicious Devices in Public Spaces: Why Vigilance Still Matters Lessons from the March 2026 Fort Washington Park incident on why public reporting, visible patrols and coordinated response protect open spaces. Published Apr 23, 2026 Reading time 4 min read Author Securemedy Incorporated Category Public Safety In This Article In March 2026, authorities investigated suspected explosive devices found in a remote area of Fort Washington Park in Prince George’s County, Maryland. The response involved the U.S. Park Police, the county bomb squad and state and federal partners, and no civilians were harmed. The article uses the incident to explain why parks, parking areas and other open facilities are considered soft targets, and what that means for security planning. Key Takeaways Open access, high foot traffic and limited permanent security make public spaces harder to protect. Public reporting matters: the response began because something unusual was noticed and reported early. Active patrols and visible monitoring reduce the opportunity to act undetected. Safe outcomes depend on coordinated response between local, state and federal agencies. sources.text: Security Personnel Services | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › Services › Security Personnel Security Personnel Professional Security Personnel You Can Rely On . Trained, supervised security officers who help create a safer environment for your people, property and operations. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Trained & Supervised Officers Backed by experienced corporate oversight Armed & Unarmed Coverage Matched to your site's risk profile Professional & Courteous Security with a customer-service mindset Flexible Staffing Short- and long-term assignments Our Security Personnel Services . Securemedy assigns well-trained security professionals, supervised by an experienced and team-oriented corporate staff, to protect your facility and the people in it. Every assignment is built around your site's requirements, so your officers represent your organization with professionalism, vigilance and integrity. Request Proposal Uniformed Security Officers A visible, professional presence that deters incidents and reassures staff and visitors. Armed & Unarmed Security Armed or unarmed coverage, recommended after assessing your site and its risks. Site & Facility Security Officers posted to office buildings, facilities and commercial properties. Short- & Long-Term Staffing Staffing plans for ongoing posts, special assignments and changing needs. Supervision & Oversight Structured supervision so every post performs to a consistent standard. On Time Response | Real Time Events Why Choose Our Security Personnel ? Security is only as strong as the people delivering it. We focus on the fundamentals that make officers effective on every shift. Well Trained Officers prepared for security procedures, emergency response and customer service. Situational Awareness Attentive officers who notice, report and respond to what is happening on site. Professional & Courteous Officers who represent your organization with integrity and respect. Supervised & Supported Corporate oversight and supervision keep performance consistent. Our Process . Site security and patrol services that protect construction projects, personnel, equipment and materials through every phase of work. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Industry Overview Securing Construction Sites Construction sites change constantly, hold valuable equipment and materials, and are often unattended after hours. That combination makes them attractive targets for theft, vandalism and trespassing. Securemedy provides on-site officers, mobile patrols and access control tailored to your project schedule, with coverage that adjusts as the site evolves. Security Challenges The Risks We Plan Around . Every environment has its own risk profile. These are the challenges we plan for in construction settings. 01 Site Access Controlling entry for workers, contractors, vehicles and deliveries. 02 Equipment Protection Protecting machinery, tools and materials from theft and damage. 03 Unauthorized Entry Preventing trespassing and vandalism on open or partially fenced sites. 04 After-Hours Security Covering nights, weekends and holidays when sites are unattended. 05 Changing Site Conditions Adapting coverage as the layout and risks of the site change. sources.text: Our Story | About Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › About Us › Our Story Our Story Built on Trust. Driven by Service . Since 2009, Securemedy Incorporated has grown from a founding vision into a multi-state provider of professional security and protective services. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Founded in 2009 An American-Owned Security Company . Securemedy Incorporated was founded as an American-owned and American-managed, diversified security services provider. From the start, the goal was to become a reputable leader in providing diversified physical and electronic security services to public and private entities. That growth has been powered by the commitment and leadership of our Chairman and CEO, Olabanji "B.J." Folayan, and by the men and women who have worked diligently on site and in our corporate office to make Securemedy an emerging national leader in the security industry. Growth & Evolution Our Journey So Far . 01 2009 Securemedy is founded Securemedy Incorporated is founded as an American-owned and American-managed, diversified security services provider. 02 2009 A clear goal The founding vision: become a reputable leader in diversified physical and electronic security services to public and private entities in at least 15 states by 2020. 03 2018 Two years ahead of schedule Securemedy becomes a full-scale security provider in 16 states and counting, two years ahead of its original goal. 04 Today Serving across sectors Securemedy provides personnel, patrol, access control, risk management and security technology services to public and private clients. Service Philosophy On Time Response | Real Time Events At Securemedy, Incorporated, we promise to take an aggressive approach to offering superior security solutions at a competitive cost. We provide a superior level of service by assigning well-trained security professionals supervised by an experienced, educated and team-oriented corporate staff. This is a non-negotiable for each and every Securemedy Associate, and our pledge to each and every one of our clients. People + Technology Physical and Electronic Security, Delivered by People . Securemedy was founded to provide both physical and electronic security. Our officers are supported by video surveillance, access control, alarm response and control-room operations where our clients need them. Behind it all is a founding principle: “If you take care of your people, they will take care of your company.” Our employees are our internal customers, and they are as valuable to our success as our external customers. sources.text: Why Securemedy: A Reintroduction | Securemedy Security Insights Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Insights › Why Securemedy: A Reintroduction to the Team Protecting What Matters Most September 10, 2026 Why Securemedy: A Reintroduction to the Team Protecting What Matters Most A refresher on what Securemedy stands for: the tradeoffs behind every security plan, a people-first philosophy and the standard behind our motto. Securemedy has grown since 2009 contract by contract and site by site, and today holds security agency licenses across multiple states. This article reintroduces the company to clients who know us and to organizations meeting us for the first time. It walks through the decisions every security plan comes down to, explains why our success depends on people rather than any one person, and describes how On Time Response | Real Time Events shapes scheduling, supervision and response. Key Takeaways Armed or unarmed coverage should follow the site, its risk profile and its regulatory environment. Contracted security brings trained personnel, backup coverage, licensing management and accountability structures. Technology extends visibility, but trained officers provide judgment in real time. Most well-protected sites use both. Static posts and mobile patrol serve different needs, and many sites use a blend matched to their layout and budget. Read the full article on securemedy.com (6 min read). Related: About Securemedy More Insights Latest From Securemedy . sources.text: What Real Protection Actually Looks Like | Securemedy Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Insights › What Real Protection Actually Looks Like August 12, 2026 What Real Protection Actually Looks Like A uniform shows that someone is present. Real protection is built earlier, in how a company hires, trains, supervises and responds. Most people picture security as an officer near an entrance. This article argues that the picture is incomplete: protection is built long before an officer arrives on site, through hiring, training, supervision and the way a company responds when something goes wrong. It draws on Securemedy’s years of operation since 2009 and sets out three qualities that define dependable protection, along with the questions worth asking when you evaluate a provider. Key Takeaways Consistency: reliable scheduling and backup coverage matter as much as who shows up on day one. Judgment: training prepares officers to read a situation, de-escalate and coordinate with authorities. Accountability: supervisors who check in and reporting that is actually reviewed. When choosing a provider, ask how they train and supervise, how long they have operated and what happens when something goes wrong. Read the full article on securemedy.com (5 min read). It draws on Securemedy’s years of operation since 2009 and sets out three qualities that define dependable protection, along with the questions worth asking when you evaluate a provider. Key Takeaways Consistency: reliable scheduling and backup coverage matter as much as who shows up on day one. Judgment: training prepares officers to read a situation, de-escalate and coordinate with authorities. Accountability: supervisors who check in and reporting that is actually reviewed. When choosing a provider, ask how they train and supervise, how long they have operated and what happens when something goes wrong. Read the full article on securemedy.com (5 min read). sources.text: Armed vs. Unarmed Security Guards | Securemedy Security Insights Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Insights › Armed vs. Unarmed Security Guards: How to Choose What’s Right for Your Property June 4, 2026 Armed vs. Unarmed Security Guards: How to Choose What’s Right for Your Property Armed or unarmed coverage should be a site-by-site assessment, not a default setting. Here are the factors worth weighing. Facility managers and business owners often ask whether they need armed security or whether unarmed coverage is enough. Securemedy treats the question as a site-by-site assessment rather than a default. The article explains how the two differ in training, licensing and the risks they are suited to, lists the factors worth weighing, and describes how Securemedy starts with a site assessment before recommending a posture. Key Takeaways Unarmed officers are trained in observation, access control, de-escalation, report writing and emergency response coordination. Armed coverage carries additional certification and ongoing firearms qualification, and suits sites with higher documented risk, cash handling or high-value assets. Weigh actual risk history, insurance and contract requirements, local licensing law, foot traffic and stakeholder expectations. Securemedy is as comfortable recommending unarmed coverage as armed. The goal is fit, not upsell. Read the full article on securemedy.com (5 min read). Related: Security Personnel More Insights Latest From Securemedy . sources.description: The $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge (2024) rewarded uniformed Securemedy security personnel for professional appearance. Prizes, eligibility and judging.
sources.text: Announcements: $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge | Securemedy Skip to content Home › Resources › Announcements Announcements $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge . Rewarding our security personnel for their professional appearance. First Place: $5,000 Second $2,500 · Third $1,000 Contest Period August 1 to October 31, 2024 Status: Closed Registration ended August 30, 2024 Status: Closed This challenge has closed . Registration ended on Friday, August 30, 2024, and final selections were scheduled for November 30, 2024. The details below are kept for reference. For questions, contact the Office Administrator at admin@securemedy.com. Our Objective Recognizing Professional Appearance . The purpose of this challenge is to motivate and reward our security personnel for maintaining and enhancing their professional appearance, which reflects the company’s commitment to excellence and professionalism at all worksites. ✓ Eligibility: open to all uniformed security personnel employed by the company and in good standing. Prize Categories Three Ways to Be Recognized . $5,000 First Place Our top prize! This substantial reward goes to the security personnel who best exemplifies our standards of professionalism and excellence. $2,500 Second Place Still a significant reward, the second place prize is for the personnel who comes close to meeting the high bar set by our first place winner. $1,000 Third Place Recognition for your commitment to maintaining a professional appearance, the third place prize is our way of saying ‘well done’. Evaluation Criteria CEO Directive CD_007: Image and Appearance Standards . Note: Eligible participants must meet all of the mandatory requirements as outlined in CEO Directive CD 007.1, Image and Appearance Standards. No exceptions. Uniform Neatness and Fit We’re looking for security personnel who wear their uniforms with pride. Your uniform should be properly fitted, clean, and well-maintained. Grooming Personal grooming is a key part of professional appearance. Compliance with our grooming policy is essential, which includes aspects like hair, facial hair, nails, and personal hygiene. Professionalism Professionalism isn’t just about how you look, it’s also about how you act. We’ll be evaluating your posture, communication, and conduct. Consistency Consistency is key in this challenge. We’re looking for security personnel who maintain high appearance standards throughout the contest period. Contest Period How the Challenge Worked . The $5,000 Image Excellence Challenge takes place from August 1, 2024, to October 31, 2024. During this 3-month period, participants must register, maintain a professional appearance, and be evaluated by a judging panel. Winners will be announced after October 31, 2024. Registration Form ✓ Name ✓ Employee ID ✓ Work / job site ✓ Email ✓ Work schedule ✓ Extra credit exercise Entry Process ✓ Step 1: Registration Form. Participants must complete a registration form. ✓ Step 2: Two Uniform Pictures. Registration must include 2 clear pictures of officer in uniform (head to toe), including a front view and a rear view. ✓ Step 3: Submit by Email. sources.text: Privacy Policy | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › Privacy Policy Privacy Policy Privacy Policy . Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our M3dyHub mobile application and our company website. Information Collection and Use We collect two types of information: Personal Data These are information that can be used to identify you, such as: i. Name ii. Email address iii. Profile information iv. Phone Number Non-Personal Data These are information that cannot be used to identify you, such as: i. Device operating system ii. Device type iii. Usage data iv. Analytics data How we use Personal Information We use your Personal Data to: i. Provide and enhance our Application and website ii. Notify you about updates and changes iii. Respond to your support requests iv. Comply with legal requirements We use Non-Personal Data to: i. Analyze usage trends ii. Improve our Application and Services iii. Provide targeted advertising with appropriate user consent Information Sharing We do not share your Personal Data with third parties for marketing purposes. With your consent we may share personal data with service providers who help us administer our services. Marketing and Consent We respect your privacy and will not use the collected data for unsolicited marketing purposes. You may opt out of receiving communication by following the instructions provided or by contacting us. Opt-Out: I have the right to opt-out of receiving SMS messages from Securemedy at any time. To do so, I can reply with “STOP” to any message received, or I can contact Securemedy’s HR department to request opt-out. No further messages will be sent after opting out. Data Security We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse, including: i. Encryption ii. Firewalls iii. Secure servers iv. Access controls Data Retention We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as necessary for our services. We may retain information as needed to comply with legal obligations or resolve disputes. User Rights You have rights concerning your Personal Data, including: i. Access and correction ii. Deletion or “Right to be forgotten” iii. Objection to processing iv. Restriction of processing v. Data Portability Policy Updates We may update this Privacy Policy periodically and will notify you of significant changes through updates on our Application and website. Contact Information For inquiries about this privacy policy, reach us at: i. itsupport.team@securemedy.com ii. info@securemedy.com Data Controller Securemedy Incorporated 8507 Oxon Hill Road, Suite 101, Fort Washington, MD 20744, USA. Contact Our Team Data Protection Officer M3dyHub Team - itsupport.team@securemedy.com Compliance with Global Standards We adhere to global privacy standards, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), providing you with rights such as data access, correction, deletion, and portability. You may lodge a complaint with the appropriate data protection authority if necessary. Our use of cookies enhances your experience on the Application and website. Manage your preference via browser settings. Third-Party Services We may use third-party services to support our Application and website which do not access your Personal Data without your explicit consent. Data Breach Notification In case of a data breach, we will notify affected individuals and the relevant authorities within defined timelines, in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations. App Store Compliance We comply with the privacy and data security standards required by Google Play Store and Apple Store ensuring protection of user’s data. Information Sharing Phone numbers or SMS consents are not shared with third parties for marketing purposes. All sharing of information is done in alignment with the user consent and legal requirements. Get Started Request Proposal Tell us about your facility and our team will follow up to scope the right solution. Prefer to talk now? Call (240) 419-3125 .

sources.title: Leadership | Securemedy Incorporated
sources.description: Meet Olabanji O. Folayan, Chairman and CEO of Securemedy Incorporated, and learn how experienced leadership guides our security services.
sources.text: Leadership | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › About Us › Leadership Leadership Guided by Experience. Committed to Excellence . Securemedy is led by credentialed security professionals who have built the company on discipline, service and care for its people. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Chairman/CEO Chairman & Chief Executive Officer Olabanji O. Folayan ✓ Certified Protection Professional (CPP), ASIS International ✓ Board-Certified Project Manager (CPM), IAPPM ✓ B.A. in Business, M.S. in Management, and a Graduate Certificate in Homeland Security Management, University of Maryland University College ✓ CHS-V designation through the American Board for Certification in Homeland Security ✓ 23 years of experience in various security and emergency management positions Olabanji O. Folayan was born and raised in the Washington Metropolitan Area, and attended the University of the District of Columbia (B.A., Business Administration, 1997) and the University of Maryland (M.S. Management, 2004, and Graduate Certificate in Homeland Security Management, 2007). Prior to establishing Securemedy, Incorporated, Mr. Folayan worked in various capacities from security officer to management, working on commercial and government contracts. He has provided oversight for a workforce of over 300 employees. His duties included management oversight for short-term and long-term objectives, contract negotiations, financial analysis and reporting, contract oversight, maintaining labor relations and strategic management of contract security services functions. With regards to professional certifications, he has attained Certified Protection Professional (CPP) status with ASIS International. He also holds Certified in Homeland Security (CHS-V) status with the American Board for Certification in Homeland Security, and is a board-certified Program Manager (CPM) with the International Association of Project and Program Managers. Professional Affiliations ✓ American Society for Industrial Security (ASIS) International ✓ American Board for Certification in Homeland Security (ABCHS) ✓ International Association of Project and Program Management (IAPPM) ✓ Washington Area Security Managers Association (WASMA) How We Lead Leadership That Starts With People . Leadership Philosophy “Our success depends on people, never on a person.” Leadership at Securemedy is shared by the corporate staff and the officers who serve on site every day. Operational Leadership Our leadership has worked in roles from security officer to management on commercial and government contracts, and understands operations from the post up. Commitment to Clients Every client is served by well-trained security professionals supervised by an experienced, educated and team-oriented corporate staff. People & Professional Development We are on a mission to improve the quality of security services and to enhance the image of security as a career, developing a higher caliber of leaders. Lead With Us “Our success depends on people, never on a person.” Olabanji O. Folayan · Chairman/CEO Securemedy is built on the principle that if you take care of your people, they will take care of your company. We equip our people with a broader understanding of security management and the skills to lead coordinated, high-profile security operations. View Careers Employee Resources Partner with Securemedy Our People. Your Peace of Mind . Let's discuss how Securemedy can support your organization with a customized security solution. Request Proposal Contact Us Get Started Request Proposal Tell us about your facility and our team will follow up to scope the right solution. Prefer to talk now? Call (240) 419-3125 .

sources.title: Mission, Vision & Values | Securemedy Incorporated
sources.description: Securemedy's mission, vision and core values: integrity, professionalism, reliability, accountability and client-focused service.
sources.text: Mission, Vision & Values | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › About Us › Mission, Vision & Values Mission, Vision & Values Purpose Behind Every Protection Plan . Our mission, vision and values guide how we recruit, train, supervise and serve, on every post and every contract. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Our Mission Why We Do What We Do . To detect vulnerabilities, deter threats, and observe risks to our client's assets, report our findings, and suggest protective measures through superior security services. At Securemedy, Incorporated, we promise to take an aggressive approach to offering superior security solutions at a competitive cost. Our corporate motto, On Time Response | Real Time Events, is the standard behind every assignment. Our Vision A Reputable Leader in Security . To be a reputable leader in providing diversified physical and electronic security services to public and private entities across multiple states. Securemedy Incorporated was founded as an American-owned and American-managed, diversified security services provider. Our vision was to become a reputable leader in providing diversified physical and electronic security services to public and private entities in at least 15 states by 2020. As of 2018, Securemedy Incorporated became a full-scale security provider in 16 states and counting, two years ahead of schedule, thanks to the commitment of our leadership and the men and women who serve on site and in our corporate office. 16 states as of 2018 Our Core Values The Standards We Live By . 01 Integrity We do what we say, and represent our clients with honesty and discretion. 02 Professionalism Well-trained, well-presented officers supervised by an experienced corporate staff. 03 Reliability On time response and consistent coverage our clients can depend on. 04 Accountability Clear supervision, reporting and ownership of results on every post. 05 Client-Focused Service Your mission drives the security program we build around it. Values in Practice How Our Values Shape Service . Values only matter when they show up on the job. Here is how ours translate into the service our clients experience every day. Our Approach Personnel We assign well-trained professionals and support them with experienced, team-oriented supervision. Response On Time Response | Real Time Events is the standard we hold every post to. Communication Structured communication keeps clients informed and issues escalated quickly. Accountability Supervision and reporting create a clear record of what happens on every post. Client Relationships We learn your mission so our security program supports it. Operational Consistency Multi-layered quality control and quality assurance procedures keep standards consistent. Put our values to work Request Proposal . Let's discuss how Securemedy can build a security program around your mission. Request Proposal Contact Us Get Started Request Proposal Tell us about your facility and our team will follow up to scope the right solution. Prefer to talk now? Call (240) 419-3125 .

sources.text: Our Approach | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › About Us › Our Approach Our Approach More Than Security. A Trusted Partner . Securemedy does not simply provide personnel. We build security programs around your people, facilities, risks and operations. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team What We Build Around Six Inputs to Every Security Program . Every Securemedy program starts from the same six considerations, weighted to fit your environment. People Trained, supervised officers are the foundation of every program. Technology Video surveillance, access control and alarm systems extend what officers can see. Intelligence Information from assessments, patrols and reporting informs every decision. Risk Programs are shaped by the vulnerabilities and threats specific to your site. Operations Post orders, supervision and procedures that fit how your facility runs. Client Requirements Your mission, standards and budget define the solution. Our Process A Structured Approach to Your Security Needs . The same four steps guide every engagement, from a single site to a multi-state program. Explore Our Services 01 Assess Understand the environment, risks and requirements. 02 Design Develop a customized security plan. 03 Deploy Deploy trained professionals and appropriate technology. 04 Manage Continuously monitor, supervise and improve performance. Integrated Approach People. Technology. Intelligence . We combine trained security professionals, proven processes and technology to deliver effective, reliable and responsive security solutions for every client. ✓ Layered Security Solutions: people, technology and operational intelligence working together for stronger protection. ✓ Site-Specific Security Plans: customized programs based on your facility, people and operational requirements. ✓ Proactive Risk Management: identify, assess and mitigate risks before they escalate. ✓ Continuous Support: structured communication, supervision and rapid response. sources.text: Access Control Services | Securemedy Incorporated Skip to content Home › Services › Access Control Access Control Control Access. Protect What Matters . Access control services that help you manage who enters your facility, verify credentials and keep sensitive areas secure. Request Proposal Talk to Our Team Visitor Screening Registration and visitor management Secure Entry & Exit Consistent procedures at every access point Credential Verification Identification checked before entry Restricted Areas Protection for sensitive spaces Our Access Control Services . Access control is one of the most effective ways to prevent incidents before they start. Securemedy combines trained officers, clear procedures and, where installed, your access-control technology to make sure only authorized people reach the right places. Request Proposal Controlled Entry Officers manage entrances and exits to keep access points secure. Visitor Management Screen, register and track visitors with clear sign-in and sign-out. Credential Verification Check identification and credentials to prevent unauthorized entry. Access Monitoring Monitor access points, including CCTV where installed, to deter suspicious activity. Front Desk Support Reception security that welcomes visitors while enforcing procedures. Restricted-Area Management Additional protection for sensitive and high-value areas. On Time Response | Real Time Events Why Choose Our Access Control Services ? We combine professional personnel, proven procedures and a client-focused approach to deliver reliable access control. Stronger Entry Security Consistent procedures that reduce the risk of unauthorized access. Trained Officers Personnel who apply access procedures the same way every time. Tailored Procedures Built around your facility, people and operations. Improved Accountability Visitor logs and reporting for better visibility and control. Our Access Control Process . Assess · Design · Deploy · Manage 01 Assess Assessment We evaluate your facility, access points and security requirements. 02 Design Customized Plan We develop access procedures and staffing plans. 03 Deploy Implementation Trained officers and procedures are deployed to your site. 04 Manage Monitoring & Support Ongoing supervision and adjustments keep it effective. sources.description: The Securemedy hiring process: apply, interview, train and succeed. What to prepare, what happens at each stage, required documents and training expectations.
sources.text: Hiring Process | Careers at Securemedy Skip to content Home › Careers › Hiring Process Hiring Process Your Path to Success . We make it simple to join our team. From application to training, our process is designed to help you succeed. View Open Positions Apply Now At a Glance Four Steps to Joining Our Team . Apply online, meet our team, complete your training and start building your career. Here is how each step works. 01 Apply Submit your application online with your resume and basic information. 02 Interview Meet with our team to discuss your experience and career goals. 03 Train Complete required training and certification programs. 04 Succeed Join our team and build a rewarding career with opportunities for advancement. Step by Step What to Expect at Each Stage . Requirements vary by position and jurisdiction. Each posting lists exactly what that role needs. Step 1 Apply What happens ✓ Find a position on Current Openings, or submit a general application. ✓ Apply online with your resume, cover letter and minimum hourly wage requirements. ✓ Our team reviews your application against the requirements of the posting. How to prepare ✓ An up-to-date resume ✓ A short cover letter ✓ Your minimum hourly wage requirement ✓ The days and shifts you are available Step 2 Interview What happens ✓ Qualified applicants are contacted to schedule an interview. ✓ We discuss your experience, career goals and availability. ✓ You learn about the post, its schedule and expectations. How to prepare ✓ Government-issued photo ID ✓ Your security licenses and certifications ✓ Professional appearance ✓ Questions about the role and site Step 3 Train What happens ✓ Pre-employment screening as required by the position, such as drug screening, a physical examination, a criminal background check and fingerprinting. ✓ Required training and certification programs for your post. ✓ Site orientation with your supervisor. How to prepare ✓ Keep required certifications current (for example CPR/First Aid/AED) ✓ Complete screening appointments promptly ✓ Bring your driver's license where the posting requires it Step 4 Succeed What happens ✓ Join your team on post, supported by your site supervisor. ✓ Access pay, schedules and resources through the online employee portal. ✓ Grow through voluntary professional development and advancement opportunities. How to prepare ✓ Set up your employee portal login ✓ Get to know your post orders ✓ Talk with your supervisor about your goals Required Documentation What You May Need . Have these ready to keep your application moving. Not every position needs every item. Start Your Application Resume & cover letter Summarize your security, military, law enforcement or customer service experience. Wage requirement Your minimum hourly wage requirement, as requested on our careers page. Photo identification A valid government-issued photo ID. Security license The state security officer, guard or SPO license the posting requires. Certifications Certifications named on the posting, such as CPR/First Aid/AED, OC spray, baton or handcuff. Driver's license A driver's license and clean driving record, where the posting requires it. Education A high school diploma or GED, or the education listed on the posting. Screening consent Consent to the pre-employment screening the position requires. Training Expectations Prepared for Your Post . Every Securemedy officer completes the training and certification programs their post requires. Depending on the position, that can include jurisdiction-specific licensing hours and certifications such as CPR/First Aid/AED, OC spray, baton and handcuff. Our training academy, the Security Professional Development Institute, LLC™, delivers a Security Officer Series of programs from basic security through advanced and federal security requirements. About Our Training Get Started Ready When You Are . Find a position Browse current openings and see the duties, requirements and benefits of each posting. Current Openings → Start your application Apply for a specific opening or submit a general application. Apply Now → Ask a question Our team is available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. (240) 419-3125 → Ready to Take the Next Step ? Join Securemedy and be part of a team that's making a safer tomorrow. sources.text: Why Work at Securemedy | Culture & Careers Skip to content Home › Careers › Why Work at Securemedy Why Work at Securemedy More Than a Job. A Career with Purpose . You'll be part of a company that values professionalism, integrity and service. We are committed to your success and provide the resources you need to grow. View Open Positions Our People First Take Care of Your People . Securemedy Incorporated is built on a founding principle: “If you take care of your people, they will take care of your company.” Our employees are our internal customers, and they are as valuable to our success as our external customers. We are on a mission to improve the overall quality of security services as an industry, while enhancing the image of security as a career in the professional arena. Our Culture What It Means to Work Here . Meaningful Work Protect people, property and communities every day. Professional Environment Structured posts, clear procedures and experienced supervision. Career Growth Advance from officer to supervisor, manager and beyond. Training Paid training and voluntary professional development programs. Team Culture Employees are our internal customers, as valuable as our clients. Diverse Opportunities Roles across industries, sites and schedules. Service We serve clients, visitors and communities with care. Professionalism Well-trained, well-presented and well-supervised officers. Integrity We do what we say, with honesty and discretion. Community Impact Safer schools, workplaces, homes and public spaces. Life at Securemedy Built Around Service . Well-trained security professionals, supervised by an experienced, educated and team-oriented corporate staff. That is our commitment to clients, and the standard we support every officer to meet. Our Mission & Values Professional Environment Work with experienced professionals in a structured and supportive setting. Diverse Opportunities Roles across multiple industries and locations with room for growth. Make a Real Impact Help protect people, property and communities every day. Your Path to Success Our Hiring Process . We make it simple to join our team. From application to training, our process is designed to help you succeed. Our Hiring Process 01 Apply Submit your application online with your resume and basic information. 02 Interview Meet with our team to discuss your experience and career goals. 03 Train Complete required training and certification programs. 04 Succeed Join our team and build a rewarding career with opportunities for advancement. Where You Can Serve Careers Across Industries . Securemedy officers protect government facilities, healthcare campuses, offices, schools, residential communities, venues and more. Industries We Serve Government & Public Sector Security solutions for federal, state and local government facilities, personnel and public-sector environments. Learn more → Healthcare Security support for hospitals, medical facilities and healthcare environments where safety, access control and continuity are essential. Learn more → Corporate & Commercial Professional security for office buildings, corporate campuses, commercial properties and business environments. Learn more → Education Security solutions designed for schools, colleges and universities with open, high-traffic environments. Learn more → Residential Communities Security solutions for residential communities, managed properties, homeowners associations and apartment environments. sources.text: Campus Safety Officer (Unarmed SPO), Washington, DC | Securemedy Skip to content Home › Careers › Current Openings › Campus Safety Officer (Unarmed SPO) Unarmed Security Officer Campus Safety Officer (Unarmed SPO) Serve as a visible ambassador for safety on a school campus, combining access control, patrols, customer service and emergency response. Apply Now View on Career Portal Overview Securemedy Incorporated is seeking experienced full-time Campus Safety Officers (Unarmed SPOs) to join our team in Washington, DC. The ideal candidates are professional, dependable and committed to maintaining a safe and secure campus environment while providing exceptional customer service to students, staff, faculty and visitors. At Securemedy, campus safety is about more than security. It is about creating a welcoming, supportive and safe environment where the school community feels respected and protected. Responsibilities Foster a safe, welcoming and supportive campus environment. Provide exceptional customer service to students, staff, families and visitors. Monitor entrances, manage visitor access and support access control procedures. Conduct routine patrols to identify and address safety concerns. Support student arrival, dismissal, events and daily campus operations. Respond promptly to emergencies, medical incidents and safety concerns. Use de-escalation techniques to manage conflicts professionally. Collaborate with school leadership, faculty and emergency responders. Prepare accurate incident reports and documentation. Provide coverage across multiple campus locations as needed. Qualifications High school diploma or GED. At least 21 years old. Ability to stand, walk and remain alert for extended periods (8–12 hours). Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions. Strong communication, customer service, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills. Professionalism, sound judgment and respect for diverse populations. Requirements, Licenses & Screening Active DC Special Police Officer (SPO) license CPR/First Aid/AED certification OC spray certification Baton certification Handcuff certification Successful drug screening and physical examination Preferred Qualifications Prior school security, campus safety, military, law enforcement or related experience. Benefits Competitive pay Paid training Comprehensive benefits, including employee free healthcare Professional development and advancement opportunities Overtime opportunities as needed Securemedy offers a variety of company benefits based on the position and site location. The ideal candidates are professional, dependable and committed to maintaining a safe and secure campus environment while providing exceptional customer service to students, staff, faculty and visitors. At Securemedy, campus safety is about more than security. It is about creating a welcoming, supportive and safe environment where the school community feels respected and protected. Responsibilities Foster a safe, welcoming and supportive campus environment. Provide exceptional customer service to students, staff, families and visitors. Monitor entrances, manage visitor access and support access control procedures. Conduct routine patrols to identify and address safety concerns. Support student arrival, dismissal, events and daily campus operations. Respond promptly to emergencies, medical incidents and safety concerns. Use de-escalation techniques to manage conflicts professionally. Collaborate with school leadership, faculty and emergency responders. Prepare accurate incident reports and documentation. Provide coverage across multiple campus locations as needed. Qualifications High school diploma or GED. At least 21 years old. Ability to stand, walk and remain alert for extended periods (8–12 hours). Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions. Strong communication, customer service, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills. Professionalism, sound judgment and respect for diverse populations. Securemedy Incorporated is an American-owned and American-managed security services provider founded in 2009. We provide physical and electronic security services to public and private organizations, from security personnel and patrol to access control, risk management and security technology. Where is Securemedy headquartered? Our corporate headquarters is at 8507 Oxon Hill Road, Suite 101, Fort Washington, MD 20744. The office is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and can be reached at (240) 419-3125 or info@securemedy.com. What does “On Time Response | Real Time Events” mean? It is our corporate motto and the standard we hold ourselves to. Security incidents do not happen at convenient times, so our scheduling, supervision and response are built around punctuality and situational awareness. What security services do you provide? Our services include security personnel, patrol services, access control, risk management, executive protection, security consulting and security technology. Do you provide both armed and unarmed security officers? Yes. Our security personnel services include armed and unarmed officers, front desk and reception security, and professional security staffing. We recommend a level of coverage site by site, based on risk, contract requirements and local licensing law. Read our guide to choosing. Partner with Securemedy Need Help With Your Security Needs ? Frequently Asked Questions Resources Support . Need help finding something, or have a question about our services? Start here, or contact our team. View All FAQs What does Securemedy Incorporated do? Securemedy Incorporated is an American-owned and American-managed security services provider founded in 2009. We provide physical and electronic security services to public and private organizations, from security personnel and patrol to access control, risk management and security technology. Where is Securemedy headquartered? Our corporate headquarters is at 8507 Oxon Hill Road, Suite 101, Fort Washington, MD 20744. The office is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and can be reached at (240) 419-3125 or info@securemedy.com. What does “On Time Response | Real Time Events” mean? It is our corporate motto and the standard we hold ourselves to. Security incidents do not happen at convenient times, so our scheduling, supervision and response are built around punctuality and situational awareness. What security services do you provide? Our services include security personnel, patrol services, access control, risk management, executive protection, security consulting and security technology. Do you provide both armed and unarmed security officers? Yes. Our security personnel services include armed and unarmed officers, front desk and reception security, and professional security staffing. We recommend a level of coverage site by site, based on risk, contract requirements and local licensing law. Read our guide to choosing. Partner with Securemedy Need Help With Your Security Needs ? Quick answers about Securemedy, our services and how we support clients and employees. Contact Our Team General What does Securemedy Incorporated do? Securemedy Incorporated is an American-owned and American-managed security services provider founded in 2009. We provide physical and electronic security services to public and private organizations, from security personnel and patrol to access control, risk management and security technology. Where is Securemedy headquartered? Our corporate headquarters is at 8507 Oxon Hill Road, Suite 101, Fort Washington, MD 20744. The office is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and can be reached at (240) 419-3125 or info@securemedy.com. What does “On Time Response | Real Time Events” mean? It is our corporate motto and the standard we hold ourselves to. Security incidents do not happen at convenient times, so our scheduling, supervision and response are built around punctuality and situational awareness. Services What security services do you provide? Our services include security personnel, patrol services, access control, risk management, executive protection, security consulting and security technology. Do you provide both armed and unarmed security officers? Yes. Our security personnel services include armed and unarmed officers, front desk and reception security, and professional security staffing. We recommend a level of coverage site by site, based on risk, contract requirements and local licensing law. Read our guide to choosing. How do you decide what my site needs? We start with an assessment of your environment, risks and requirements, then design a customized plan, deploy trained professionals and appropriate technology, and continue to monitor, supervise and improve performance. See our approach. Can officers and security technology work together? Yes. Technology such as video surveillance, access control and alarms extends visibility, while trained officers provide judgment and real-time response. Most well-protected sites use both. Industries What industries do you serve? We serve government and public sector, healthcare, corporate and commercial, construction, education, retail, hospitality and events, residential communities, industrial and manufacturing, and transportation and logistics clients. Explore industries. Do you work with government agencies? Yes. Securemedy carries the responsibilities of a federal contractor, and our performance record includes work with the U.S. Army Barnes Federal Building in Boston, the U.S. Coast Guard in Baltimore and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency in Edison, New Jersey. Licenses & Credentials Where is Securemedy licensed? Securemedy holds security agency licenses in the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia and West Virginia. View license numbers. What certifications and designations do you hold? Securemedy is SBA 8(a) certified, DC DBE certified, MD MBE and DBE certified, and VA DBE and SWaM certified. What are your NAICS codes? 561612, 561110, 561210, 561611, 561621, 928110, 611430, 541611 and 541990. Employees & Careers How do I apply for a position? Browse current openings and apply online with your resume, cover letter and minimum hourly wage requirements. When are employees paid? Employees are paid semi-monthly, on the 10th and 25th of each month. If either day falls on a Saturday, pay day is the Friday before. Who is eligible for benefits, and when do they start? Employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week are eligible for medical, dental and vision insurance. For eligible new hires, benefits start on the first of the month following 90 days from the hire date. How do I view my pay stubs or set up direct deposit? Use the Employee Login portal. First-time users register by selecting “Sign-Up”. To set up direct deposit, open My Pay from the main menu and enter your banking information. How can I report a concern anonymously? sources.title: Security Guides & Checklists | Securemedy Resources
sources.description: Security guides and checklists from Securemedy: armed or unarmed coverage, choosing a provider, public-space vigilance and combining officers with technology.
sources.text: Security Guides & Checklists | Securemedy Resources Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Guides Security Guides Practical Guidance for a Safer Tomorrow . Guides and checklists to help you strengthen security, reduce risk and create safer environments for your people, property and operations. Expert Guidance Drawn from our published articles Practical Checklists Questions and steps you can use today Linked to Services See how each guide applies on site Featured Security Guides Guidance You Can Put to Work . Each guide distills practical advice from Securemedy’s published articles into a checklist you can use when planning or reviewing security. Security Planning Choosing Between Armed and Unarmed Coverage A checklist for deciding which level of coverage fits your site. ✓ Review the site’s actual incident history, not a general sense of unease. ✓ Check insurance and contract requirements for a minimum coverage level. ✓ Confirm local licensing law, which varies by state. ✓ Consider the nature of foot traffic and who uses the site. ✓ Account for client and stakeholder expectations at public-facing sites. Security Personnel → Security Planning Four Decisions Behind Every Security Plan The tradeoffs to settle before you choose a security posture. ✓ Armed or unarmed, based on the site, risk profile and regulations. ✓ In-house or contracted security, based on resources and risk tolerance. ✓ Cameras and technology alongside officers, not instead of them. ✓ Static posts, mobile patrol or a blend matched to layout and budget. Our Approach → Choosing a Provider Questions to Ask a Security Provider What to ask beyond the uniform and the sales pitch. ✓ How do you train officers, and how is that training kept current? ✓ How are shifts supervised, and how is reporting reviewed? ✓ How is backup coverage handled when an officer is unavailable? ✓ How long have you been operating, and are you licensed where I need coverage? ✓ What happens on the night something actually goes wrong? sources.description: Suspicious devices in public spaces: lessons from the March 2026 Fort Washington Park incident on public reporting, visible patrols and coordinated response.
sources.text: Suspicious Devices in Public Spaces | Securemedy Security Insights Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Insights › Suspicious Devices in Public Spaces: Why Vigilance Still Matters April 23, 2026 Suspicious Devices in Public Spaces: Why Vigilance Still Matters Lessons from the March 2026 Fort Washington Park incident on why public reporting, visible patrols and coordinated response protect open spaces. In March 2026, authorities investigated suspected explosive devices found in a remote area of Fort Washington Park in Prince George’s County, Maryland. The response involved the U.S. Park Police, the county bomb squad and state and federal partners, and no civilians were harmed. The article uses the incident to explain why parks, parking areas and other open facilities are considered soft targets, and what that means for security planning. Key Takeaways Open access, high foot traffic and limited permanent security make public spaces harder to protect. Public reporting matters: the response began because something unusual was noticed and reported early. Active patrols and visible monitoring reduce the opportunity to act undetected. Safe outcomes depend on coordinated response between local, state and federal agencies. Read the full article on securemedy.com (4 min read). sources.text: Security Placement vs. Security Program | Securemedy Security Insights Skip to content Home › Resources › Security Insights › Security Placement vs. Security Program: Why Context Changes Everything March 13, 2026 Security Placement vs. Security Program: Why Context Changes Everything A guard at a desk is a placement. A program is built around how people, assets and information move through your space. Many security vendors focus on placement: an officer at a desk, a camera in a corner or a reader on a door, without understanding the building around them. This article explains why Securemedy builds security programs around environments instead. It sets out the questions Securemedy asks before proposing a plan, so that security reflects how a facility actually operates day to day. Key Takeaways Who moves through this space, and when? Activity changes by time of day and day of the week. Where have incidents happened, and what preceded them? What does leadership understand about current security gaps? What would a failure cost beyond the immediate incident? Read the full article on securemedy.com (5 min read). Related: Security Consulting More Insights Latest From Securemedy .
